import numpy as np

def transform_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df = df.drop(columns=["Customers"], errors="ignore")

    d = df["Date"].dt
    df["Year"] = d.year
    df["Month"] = d.month
    df["Day"] = d.day
    df["WeekOfYear"] = d.isocalendar().week.astype(int)
    df["DayOfYear"] = d.dayofyear
    df["Quarter"] = d.quarter
    df["IsWeekend"] = (df["DayOfWeek"] >= 6).astype(int)
    df["DaysToMonthEnd"] = d.days_in_month - df["Day"]

    # leap-year helpers (pure row-local arithmetic)
    y = df["Year"]
    is_leap = (((y % 4 == 0) & (y % 100 != 0)) | (y % 400 == 0)).astype(int)
    days_in_year = 365 + is_leap
    df["DaysInYear"] = days_in_year
    doy = df["DayOfYear"]

    # days to next New Year (Jan 1 of year+1)
    df["DaysToNewYear"] = days_in_year - doy + 1

    # days to next Christmas (Dec 25)
    # Dec 25 day-of-year depends on leapness of the target year
    dec25 = 359 + is_leap
    df["DaysToXmas"] = np.where(doy <= dec25,
                                dec25 - doy,
                                (days_in_year - doy) + (359 + is_leap + 1 - 1))

    # months since competition opened
    df["CompAgeMonths"] = (y - df["CompetitionOpenSinceYear"]) * 12 + \
                          (df["Month"] - df["CompetitionOpenSinceMonth"])
    df["CompAgeMonths"] = df["CompAgeMonths"].clip(lower=0)

    df["IsPromo2"] = (df["Promo2"] == 1).astype(int)
    df["Promo2Active"] = 0
    for col, mlist in [("Feb,May,Aug,Nov",{2,5,8,11}),
                       ("Jan,Apr,Jul,Oct",{1,4,7,10}),
                       ("Mar,Jun,Sept,Dec",{3,6,9,12})]:
        active = (df["PromoInterval"].fillna("") == col) & df["Month"].isin(mlist)
        df.loc[active, "Promo2Active"] = 1
    df["Promo2Active"] = df["IsPromo2"] * df["Promo2Active"]

    df["Promo2SinceYear"] = df["Promo2SinceYear"].fillna(y)
    df["Promo2SinceWeek"] = df["Promo2SinceWeek"].fillna(0)
    promo2_months = (y - df["Promo2SinceYear"]) * 12
    df["Promo2Months"] = (df["IsPromo2"] * promo2_months).clip(lower=0)

    return df

import numpy as np

def transform_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    dt = df["Date"]
    y = dt.dt.year.astype(int)
    doy = dt.dt.dayofyear.astype(int)
    is_leap = (((y % 4 == 0) & (y % 100 != 0)) | (y % 400 == 0)).astype(int)
    din = 365 + is_leap
    cum = np.array([0,31,59,90,120,151,181,212,243,273,304,334])

    def month_day_month(m, dd):
        # doy of month m day dd
        return ((cum[m-1] + dd) + (is_leap * (m > 2))).astype(int)

    a = y % 19; b = y // 100; c = y % 100
    d = b // 4; e = b % 4; f = (b + 8) // 25; g = (b - f + 1) // 3
    h = (19*a + b - d - g + 15) % 30; i = c // 4; k = c % 4
    l = (32 + 2*e + 2*i - h - k) % 7
    mm = (h + l - 7*((a + 11*h + 22*l) // 451) + 114) // 31
    dd = ((h + l - 7*((a + 11*h + 22*l) // 451) + 114) % 31) + 1
    easter_doy = month_day_month(mm, dd)
    gf_doy = easter_doy - 2
    em_doy = easter_doy + 1

    df["DaysToGoodFriday"] = np.where(doy <= gf_doy, gf_doy - doy, (din - doy) + gf_doy)
    df["DaysToEasterMonday"] = np.where(doy <= em_doy, em_doy - doy, (din - doy) + em_doy)
    df["DaysSinceEaster"] = np.where(doy >= easter_doy, doy - easter_doy, doy - (easter_doy - din))
    df["NearEaster"] = (np.abs(doy - easter_doy) <= 15).astype(int)
    return df

import numpy as np

def transform_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # recent trailing avg relative to seasonal baseline (recent-vs-seasonal lift)
    recent = df["Store_Sales_56_mean"]
    seas = df["Store_DayOfWeek_Sales_364_mean"]
    df["RecentVsSeasonal"] = np.where((seas > 0) & recent.notna(),
                                      recent / seas, np.nan)
    # current week's vs longer trend
    w56 = df["Store_Sales_56_mean"]
    w364 = df["Store_Sales_364_mean"]
    df["MomentumShort"] = np.where((w364 > 0) & w56.notna() & w364.notna(),
                                   w56 / w364, np.nan)
    return df
